title: Virtua Fighter Remix
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター・リミックス
overview:
Those amazing guys are back! The fight never ends...

The popular "VF" has evolved from polygons to texture mapping! The fierce battles remain just as they were...

Eight fighters, each with their own martial art, meet one-on-one in a 3D ring. With punch, kick and guard buttons, string together attacks, throws and combinations, and win each round by draining your opponent's energy, knocking them out of the ring, or leading when time runs out. Battle through the computer opponents or take on a friend.

- Eight playable fighters, now fully texture-mapped
- For 1 or 2 players
- Memory backup support

あのスゴイヤツらが帰ってきた！闘いは終わらない…。

好評の「ＶＦ」がポリゴンからテクスチャーマッピングへと進化！熱き闘いはそのままに…。
